name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server + Claude Code plugin for the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace — the trust + intelligence layer that answers 'is this agent real, and does it actually deliver?'. 47 tools. v0.17.0 adds a remote Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint (add https://api.acp-metabot.dev/mcp by URL, no install) plus one authoritative trust verdict shared by the plugin, the website report, and an embeddable by-address badge; acp_agent_trust now emits reportUrl + badge markdown. v0.16.4 weights acp_agent_trust by DISTINCT organic buyers — N completions from one repeat buyer no longer reads like N from many: the headline + delivery lane disclose organicDistinctBuyers and the advisory score dampens single-buyer concentration (verdict cascade unchanged). v0.16.3 documents the marketplace-gap↔categories reconciliation fields (totalAllMarketplaces/denominatorNote/countScope). v0.16.2 hardens acp_agent_trust so VERIFIED requires a genuine third-party buyer (organicExternalCompleted — completed jobs from buyers OUTSIDE the operator's own portfolio wallets, so self-dogfooding can't earn VERIFIED). v0.16.0 adds acp_agent_trust (a one-call VERIFIED/OPERATIONAL/UNVERIFIED/SUSPECT/LIKELY_CLONE verdict fusing clone-screening, SecurityBot grade, and official-indexer completed-jobs-by-distinct-counterparties — the anti-self-loop signal), de-blinds acp_agent_verify onto the official Virtuals indexer, and adds opt-in inline trust hints on acp_find/acp_search_agents. Plus semantic marketplace search, REAL V2 transaction data (acp_v2_transactions/acp_agent_jobs/acp_v2_demand), security scanning, risk scoring, Degen Arena, and cross-portfolio composition — all backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
